concerns.text: FR-016 – A Priori Power Analysis specifies that a power analysis must be performed and justify the dataset collection, but the spec does not state where the analysis results are to be recorded (e.g., file name, format) nor how the justification will be validated. Without a concrete artifact and verification procedure, this requirement is untestable.

SC-010 – Power analysis justification repeats the same issue as FR-016: it requires demonstration that the dataset collection meets power ≥ 0.8, yet the spec does not define an observable artifact (e.g., `power_analysis.txt` or JSON) or a reproducible check, making the success criterion unmeasurable.
